notes.title: Update 1.1 - Free Level Pack Incoming!
notes.notes:
A big disorderly update is in the pipes, including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] "To Expand" - a series of five all-new wit-testing, finger-blistering levels to further challenge those that have beaten the game
[*] new insight and/or secrets unlockable in your journal?!
[*] bug fixes and performance improvements
[*] additional third-party controller support
[/list]

You'll be able to get your hands on all of this goodness very soon!
Keep your eyes peeled and fingers at the ready!

notes.title: Official Release Date Set
notes.notes:
It's been a long road with many challenges... actually... dang. Over two years, at this point. But! [i]Disorder[/i] is now ready.  It is time.

Mark your calendars!  It is slated for release on January 13th.

And to get more insight into the game's development process, between now and release the development team will be posting "Dev Diaries" to [url=https://www.facebook.com/disordergame]our Facebook page[/url].  Be sure to like it and keep an eye out for those if you're interested in finding out more about the game and the team at Swagabyte!
